title: PassageGenerateResponse
description: 200 body of POST /v1/passages:generate (SDD 5, 11). Producer: Passage Generator in Core (W2). Consumer: Session Agent (W2), which loads the passage from passages/{passage_id}. A story that fails the gate twice, or runs past the deadline, is an error instead: {error: {code: GATE_FAILED | DEADLINE | INVALID_REQUEST, message, retryable: false}}, and the Session Agent chooses a bank passage and raises FALLBACK_PASSAGE. The generator never returns a bank passage itself.
